crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious…
Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to Yahweh, and enter into his sanctuary, which he…
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord…
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…

translations.web: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
translations.bsb: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
translations.kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
translations.asv: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not with a stiff neck.
